title: MacBrains Labs ANE Research Records
description:
Versioned, source-bound public research records from MacBrains Labs. Each version is a cumulative snapshot of the archive repository; v0.1.0 holds the original public measurement summaries and v0.2.0 the LFM3-1.7B layer-14 diagnostic record. Version v0.3.0 adds the diagnostic record ANERECore cross-repo MIL parity: tap, steer and functionWide (same chip, single device) in records/ane-record-b8f78a146608021d974dcdec/.

Scope: same-chip, single device (Mac17,5, macOS build 26C5035r); MIL text byte equality only, one Qwen fixture, operations tap, steer and functionWide; functionWide pin is Fugu-referenced; no Core ML compile, ANE execution or numerics; no novelty claim. Same-chip reruns are repeatability only, not cross-device replication. Two clean-room arms (Fugu and ANE-RE), each with a setup profile committed before its first counted run: 10 runs logged device-wide, all counted, all passed, all disclosed.

Records are reviewed summaries, not peer-reviewed results. The reported measurements have not been independently replicated by this deposit. Reviewed package SHA-256 b8f78a146608021d974dcdec34ced0407a2c8449d23eab3e416649dec221cc2e; reviewed record SHA-256 dbd33eb410dfb624158f1bcb8ff0458b72a6c8601a6dd6ad93fb349ff73081e0.
